name: Munazzah Fatima Shaikh
greetingText: Today is a little more special because it's the day you came into this world. ✨
wishText: May your life always be filled with happiness, beautiful memories, endless smiles and all the success you deserve. 🎂❤️
textInChatBox: Happy Birthday, Munazzah! ❤️ I made this little surprise especially for you. I hope it makes you smile! 😊
text2: I wanted to give you something special...
text3: But then I thought, a normal gift would never be enough.
text4: So I decided to create something
text5Content: Someone as special as you deserves a special surprise. ❤️
outroText: No matter where life takes you, I hope you always keep that beautiful smile. Keep shining, keep believing in yourself, and make this year unforgettable. ✨❤️
replayText: If this little surprise made you smile, watch it again! 😊❤️
